messages:
ama (eng-sre): Postmortem INC-2048 live. Root cause summary: cascading KV evictions exposed a slow autoscaler decision path. We agreed to ship runbook clarifications and track recurring-patterns.

ama (eng-sre): Action items I'm proposing (owners + rough due dates):
- Runbook triage gate: formal checks + exact telemetry queries (owner: ravi, due: 2025-11-10)
- Containment commands + minimal diagnostic script (owner: jo, due: 2025-11-12)
- Autoscaler-failure escalation matrix with timings and contacts (owner: kelly, due: 2025-11-09)
- Incident-pattern instrumentation: tag alerts + 30d trend review reminder (owner: ama, due: 2025-11-20)

ravi (eng-platform): Taking the triage gate. Plan: two quick queries (cache_hit_ratio, eviction_rate), a per-prefix fullness check, and a short decision table that maps metric thresholds -> next step. Will add a one-click toggle link.

jo (eng-runtime): I'll draft containment snippet. Copy/paste friendly. Example below for runbook: 

```
# containment: reduce concurrency + make cache readonly
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/inference-api -- python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=30 | jq '.prefixes[] | {prefix, filled_ratio, last_evicted_at}'
# quick grep for oncall: grep "filled_ratio" | sort -nr | head -n 6
```

jo (eng-runtime): I'll attach sample output in the PR so oncall can quickly identify hot prefixes.

kelly (infra): For escalation ladder propose concrete timings: 0-4m -> @oncall-sre, 4-12m -> @platform-pager, 12-30m -> @infra-lead + exec. I'll paste rotation links and the exact page commands in the runbook.

ama (eng-sre): Good. Also add a small "pre-paging checklist" (eg validate autoscaler events, controller-manager logs, and cluster CPU throttle metrics) so we avoid noisy pages.

ravi (eng-platform): Creating runbook draft now. Will include Grafana query and a curl probe so oncall doesn't need dashboard nav. PR will reference the postmortem.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook created by ravi: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-2048-draft PR #912.

incidents-bot: Tag applied: recurring-pattern=kv-eviction. This incident will appear in the monthly digest.

jo (eng-runtime): One question: do we include an optional automated fallback to a smaller model variant in the runbook? I think that's an Optimize scope item.

ama (eng-sre): Agreed keep runbook limited to triage + containment. I'll open a ticket for Optimize to evaluate model-variant fallback and add a link from the runbook.

ravi (eng-platform): Scheduling a 30m runbook walkthrough for oncall + platform + infra on 2025-11-11 14:00 UTC. Will add invite and include the PR link.

runbook-bot: Reminder set: runbook walkthrough 2025-11-11 14:00 UTC (invite sent).

kelly (infra): After walkthrough I'll merge the PR assuming no blockers. I'll make sure the escalation matrix has explicit contact rotations.

ama (eng-sre): I'll create follow-up reminders for the 30d trend review and check that the recurring-pattern tag surfaces in the digest. Closing thread after PR merge + walkthrough notes are posted. :thumbsup:
